title: chore(lint): reject use* functions that call no hooks
body:
The React Compiler only compiles a `use*` function as a hook if it calls a hook. A hook-less `use*` function is left as a plain function without any warning, so the closures, arrays, and objects it returns are rebuilt on every render. That already cost us caching in the web command palette (#21116) and in mobile `useThreadListActions` (#21255). The name also misleads readers and the hook lint rules.

## Sites fixed

| Site | Became |
| --- | --- |
| `apps/web` `ChatView.tsx` `useArtifactTemplate` (a local event handler) | renamed to `insertArtifactTemplate` |
| `apps/web` `hooks/useSettings.ts` `useUpdateClientSettings()` (returned a fresh closure per call) | `updateClientSettings(patch)`, a module function. Its 7 callers import it directly. `LegacySidebar` drops the `updateSettings` prop it threaded into `SidebarProjectsContent` |
| `apps/web` `onboarding/firstRun.ts` `useCompleteOnboarding()` | deleted. `completeOnboarding` is exported, and `FirstRunGate` and `WelcomeWizard` import it |
| `apps/mobile` `lib/useFontFamily.ts` `useFontFamily(weight)` | `lib/fontFamilies.ts` exports `FONT_FAMILIES`, and callers read `FONT_FAMILIES.regular` / `.bold` |

## Intentional platform stubs (kept, suppressed with a reason)

The sibling files of these stubs call real hooks, so the shared name has to stay a hook:
- `native/NativeWorkspaceColumns.tsx`: `useNativeWorkspaceColumnsReady`, `useNativeWorkspaceColumnsSupported` (the `.ios.tsx` file calls `useNativeLayoutMetrics`, `useState`, `useEffect`)
- `features/review/useReviewHeaderPresentation.android.ts`
- `features/threads/useThreadHeaderOptions.android.ts`
- `features/threads/ThreadGitControls.android.tsx`: `useThreadGitRightHeaderItems`, `useThreadGitCenterHeaderItems`, `useThreadGitMenuDefinition`

## Rule

New `t3code/no-hookless-use-function`. It reports a function declaration, or a variable bound to an arrow or function expression, named `/^use[A-Z]/` whose body (not counting nested functions) calls no `use*` / `*.use*`. React 19's `use()` counts as a hook call. A hook call that only happens inside a nested callback does not count. The rule mirrors eslint-react's [`no-unnecessary-use-prefix`](https://eslint-react.xyz/docs/rules/no-unnecessary-use-prefix). No oxlint `react/*` rule covers this, so if oxlint ever ships one, switch to it. The rule is an `error` in `apps/web/src/**` and `apps/mobile/src/**`, test files excluded. `docs/internals/web-ui.md` and `docs/internals/mobile-development.md` now mention it.

## Before / after

Web: dev server without `--watch`, data seeded with `migrate-dev-db`, legacy sidebar on. The scenario switches the thread sort order from the sidebar options menu, which goes through `updateClientSettings`. Each count is the median of 3 runs on the same base `2131698181`, from the `rc-init.js` render counter.

| Change | Scenario | Base | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `useUpdateClientSettings` → `updateClientSettings` | switch thread sort order, legacy sidebar | 190 renders / 6 commits | **169 renders** / 6 commits |
| `useCompleteOnboarding` → `completeOnboarding` | compile-level only (fires once per run) | `FirstRunGate` 63 cache slots | 62 slots. Drops a deps entry; no render difference expected |
| `ChatView` `useArtifactTemplate` rename | compiled output | 1603 slots | 1603 slots, identical apart from the renamed slot order. **No change** (a rename) |
| mobile `useFontFamily` → `FONT_FAMILIES` | compiled output | `ThreadFeed` 249, `FileMarkdownPreview` 15, `T3ComposerEditor` 36 slots | 245 / 13 / 35. The compiler now treats the font as a constant and drops its dependency checks; it was already a stable string, so **no render change** |

Where the 21 renders went: on base, the per-call closure from `useUpdateClientSettings()` changed `SidebarProjectsContent`'s `updateSettings` prop, which rebuilt the three sort handlers. `ProjectSortMenu` then re-rendered its whole menu subtree: 4 `Dialog*`, 4 `MenuGroup`, 3 `MenuRadioGroup`, and the `NumberField`. The render-cause log shows the stale prop on base (`SidebarProjectsContent props:threadSortOrder,updateSettings,deleteThread`) and not here.

## Open mobile stack

`perf/mobile-compile-8` removes the `useMemo` from `useThreadSettingsCatalogItems` (`features/threads/ThreadSettingsSheet.tsx`), which leaves it hook-less. Once that stack rebases onto main, this rule will flag it, and it needs the same fix. (`useConfirmDeleteThread` on that stack is already fixed in #21255.)

Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
